api: loadTacticalAnimations(library: ModelLibrary, asset: CharacterAsset, root: Group): Promise<{ clips: Map<string, AnimationClip>; dispose(): void }>
usage: Call before root normalization/mounting/posing. Catch rejection for fallback. Dispose returned lease on character release. ModelLibrary.acquire owns all animation resource lifetime. No old retarget.
heightCalibration: CharacterAsset runtime adults 1.75m, child1.15m; source tactical authoring adults1.8m/child1.25m. Exposed authoredHeightMeters; weapon integration must account for difference.
visualAcceptance: NOT_REVIEWED; localized rig skin strain remains candidate risk. No universal skin-quality approval.
